rv.q: Mark Babych directs a pacy production, with Biddle's music linking the whole thing together perfectly.
This unsanctimonious entertainment carries a powerful moral message.

Yet that’s exactly what writer Deborah McAndrew and composer John Biddle have done for Hull Truck’s Christmas show this season. Using a mix of carols, folk tunes and new music, it attempts to build its own identity.

cn.t: Critics praise this dark, faithful adaptation of Dickens' tale as a refreshing alternative to traditional pantomime, with strong performances and John Biddle's music effectively contrasting rich and poor worlds.
